key_idea: Reduce central nilpotency of class 2 to the single identity ((v,w,x),y,z)=1, then verify that identity with a 15-hour Waldmeister search producing 2,840 rewriting lemmas.
reason: The by-hand reduction in Step 2 has a little structure, but all the real content sits in a machine-generated equational certificate more than 1,000 pages long, and no human-readable version of it is known. It confirms the theorem without giving any reason a human can see for why abelian inner mappings force class 2.
recognized: Kinyon, Veroff, Vojtěchovský et al., 'Loops with abelian inner mapping groups: an application of automated deduction' (Bruck loop case)
